subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for plugin-observed conversation lifecycle boundaries, including atomic owner-coordinated harness release?
rationale: The reported bug and implementation are well-proven, but adding a third-party Plugin SDK mutation call is a durable API/product choice whose permanent ownership and semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the generic reset contract
options.body: Accept the documented atomic reset API and scoped ownership wrapper as the supported path for Teams and future plugin lifecycle boundaries.

options.title: Narrow the seam before merge
options.body: Keep the Teams fix but replace the public export with an internal or more constrained owner API until a broader Plugin SDK contract is designed.

options.title: Defer lifecycle reset work
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers are not ready to support either the generic API or a narrower replacement.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic reset contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented atomic reset API and scoped ownership wrapper as the supported path for Teams and future plugin lifecycle boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the only maintainer-side code contribution in this branch's lifecycle path and is the strongest available routing signal for the Teams/session decision.
